name: VORANEL
description:
About This Game

Welcome to VORANEL.

VORANEL is a linear 3D puzzle game that immerses you in a mysterious journey filled with continuous mental challenges. The protagonist awakens in an unknown place composed of sequential rooms, possessing only a single, unique device: the Builder Tool.

Gameplay: The core mechanic revolves around using the Builder Tool to construct and manipulate structures to overcome complex obstacles. Every room presents a unique challenge and a standalone puzzle that requires a blend of logical thinking, spatial engineering, and precise execution.

Key Features:

  • Progressive Challenges: A series of rooms that test your geometric and logical problem-solving skills.

  • Unique Builder Tool: Rely on a single tool to manipulate your environment, build structures, and forge new paths.

  • The Golden Rule: Think, engineer, execute, and overcome!
short_desc: A linear 3D puzzle game. Awaken in mysterious rooms and use the Builder Tool to construct structures, solve puzzles, and overcome obstacles. Think, engineer, execute!
